items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: Freddy was with me in Wilberforce

ctx.x: We've talked a little bit about Freddy Jenkins, but really not too much. I know he was with the Collegians and then later, of course, he was with Ellington.

Yes, Freddy was with me in Wilberforce, and he was quite a showman. He always carried that label, even into Duke Ellington's band. He could play, and he was a good reader. He was a good reader. And he never complained about a sore lip. That's one thing, you know. Trumpet players, a lot of them have trouble with their lips. He never had a sore lip. The only thing that -- you know, just to get on him about -- I think I mentioned it before -- he played more or less -- to an empty house he played better than he did…
